mapper.sql: k.claim_id, k.claim_no, k.cust_id, c.cust_cd, c.cust_nm, k.action_cd, k.title, k.request_text, k.reply_due, trim_scale(k.charge_amt)::text as charge_amt, k.currency_cd, k.status, k.sent_at, k.sent_by, k.answer_cause, k.answer_action, k.answered_on, k.answer_source, k.answered_by, k.closed_at, k.closed_by, k.cancel_reason, k.row_ver, k.created_at, k.created_by, k.updated_at, k.updated_by, (select count(*) from srm_claim_ncr n where n.claim_id = k.claim_id)::int as ncr_cnt
mapper.select: select x.* from () x order by x.created_at desc, x.claim_id desc limit 2000

select x.* from () x order by
x.claim_no x.cust_nm x.title x.reply_due is null, x.reply_due x.status x.created_at
desc,
x.claim_id desc limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}
select from srm_claim k join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = k.cust_id where k.claim_id = #{claimId}
select claim_id, claim_no, cust_id, status, row_ver from srm_claim where claim_id = #{claimId} for update

select n.ncr_id, n.ncr_no, n.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, trim_scale(n.nc_qty)::text as nc_qty, n.unit_cd from srm_claim_ncr n join mst_item i on i.item_id = n.item_id where n.claim_id = #{claimId} order by n.claim_ncr_id

select r.return_id as id, r.return_no as no, r.status, r.ncr_no, (r.created_at at time zone #{zone})::date as created_on from srm_return r where r.status <> 'CANCELLED' and r.ncr_id in (select n.ncr_id from srm_claim_ncr n where n.claim_id = #{claimId}) and r.cust_id = (select k.cust_id from srm_claim k where k.claim_id = #{claimId}) order by r.return_id limit 200
select n.ncr_id, k.claim_no from srm_claim_ncr n join srm_claim k on k.claim_id = n.claim_id where k.status <> 'CANCELLED' and n.ncr_id in #{i}

insert into srm_claim (comp_cd, claim_no, cust_id, action_cd, title, request_text, reply_due, charge_amt, currency_cd, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{no}, #{v.custId}, #{v.actionCd}, #{v.title}, #{v.requestText}, #{v.replyDue}, #{v.chargeAmt}, #{v.currencyCd}, #{by}, #{by}) returning claim_id
mapper.insert: insert into srm_claim_ncr (comp_cd, claim_id, ncr_id, ncr_no, item_id, nc_qty, unit_cd, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{claimId}, #{v.ncrId}, #{v.ncrNo}, #{v.itemId}, #{v.ncQty}, #{v.unitCd}, #{by}, #{by})
mapper.select: select k.claim_no, k.title, k.action_cd, trim_scale(k.charge_amt)::text as charge_amt, k.currency_cd, k.reply_due, c.cust_nm, sc.comp_nm, (select count(*) from srm_claim_ncr n where n.claim_id = k.claim_id) as ncr_cnt, coalesce((select ct.email from mst_cust_contact ct where ct.cust_id = k.cust_id and ct.use_yn = 'Y' and ct.main_yn = 'Y' and ct.email is not null order by ct.contact_id limit 1), c.email) as email from srm_claim k join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = k.cust_id join sys_comp sc on sc.comp_cd = k.comp_cd where k.claim_id = #{claimId}
